from collections import Counter

def transform(grid):
    g=[row[:] for row in grid]
    h,w=len(g),len(g[0])
    bg=Counter(x for row in g for x in row).most_common(1)[0][0]
    def runs(row):
        out=[]; c=0
        while c<w:
            if row[c]==bg: c+=1; continue
            v=row[c]; s=c
            while c<w and row[c]==v: c+=1
            out.append((s,c,v))
        return out
    top=runs(g[0]); bot=runs(g[-1])
    # two equal-color boundary bars, one on each opposite edge
    bars=[(0,*max(top,key=lambda x:x[1]-x[0])), (h-1,*max(bot,key=lambda x:x[1]-x[0]))]
    barcolor=bars[0][3]
    markers=[(r,c) for r in range(h) for c in range(w) if g[r][c]!=bg and g[r][c]!=barcolor]
    markercolor=g[markers[0][0]][markers[0][1]]
    # The marked columns within one bar define the offsets used by both bars.
    candidate=max(bars, key=lambda b:sum(1 for r,c in markers if b[1]<=c<b[2]))
    offsets=sorted({c-candidate[1] for r,c in markers if candidate[1]<=c<candidate[2]})
    for edge,s,e,color in bars:
        for off in offsets:
            c=s+off
            if c>=e: continue
            rows=range(1,h-1) if edge==0 else range(h-2,0,-1)
            for r in rows:
                g[r][c]=4 if g[r][c]==markercolor else markercolor
    return g

    h,w=len(g),len(g[0])
    bg=Counter(x for row in g for x in row).most_common(1)[0][0]
    def runs(row):
        out=[]; c=0
        while c<w:
            if row[c]==bg: c+=1; continue
            v=row[c]; s=c
            while c<w and row[c]==v: c+=1
            out.append((s,c,v))
        return out
    top=runs(g[0]); bot=runs(g[-1])
    bars=[(0,*max(top,key=lambda x:x[1]-x[0])), (h-1,*max(bot,key=lambda x:x[1]-x[0]))]

    markercolor=g[markers[0][0]][markers[0][1]]
    candidate=max(bars, key=lambda b:sum(1 for r,c in markers if b[1]<=c<b[2]))
    offsets=sorted({c-candidate[1] for r,c in markers if candidate[1]<=c<candidate[2]})
    original_markers={(r,c) for r,c in markers}

def transform(grid):
    g=[row[:] for row in grid]
    h,w=len(g),len(g[0])
    bg=Counter(x for row in g for x in row).most_common(1)[0][0]
    def runs(row):
        out=[]; c=0
        while c<w:
            if row[c]==bg: c+=1; continue
            v=row[c]; s=c
            while c<w and row[c]==v: c+=1
            out.append((s,c,v))
        return out
    bars=[(0,*max(runs(g[0]),key=lambda x:x[1]-x[0])),
          (h-1,*max(runs(g[-1]),key=lambda x:x[1]-x[0]))]
    barcolor=bars[0][3]
    markers=[(r,c) for r in range(h) for c in range(w) if g[r][c]!=bg and g[r][c]!=barcolor]
    markercolor=g[markers[0][0]][markers[0][1]]
    candidate=max(bars,key=lambda b:sum(1 for r,c in markers if b[1]<=c<b[2]))
    offsets=sorted({c-candidate[1] for r,c in markers if candidate[1]<=c<candidate[2]})
    original_markers=set(markers)
    for edge,s,e,color in bars:
        for off in offsets:
            c=s+off
            if c>=e: continue
            rows=range(1,h) if edge==0 else range(h-2,-1,-1)
            for r in rows:
                if (r,c) in original_markers:
                    g[r][c]=4
                    break
                g[r][c]=markercolor
    return g
